decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The advertisement hereby permitted shall be commenced not later than the expiration of one year from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
Condition : 4 - Where any advertisement is required under these regulations to be removed, the removal shall be carried out to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The double sided advert panel hereby approved shall be static display and not a moving display and the lighting is to be as described in the specification
Condition : 6 - The double sided advert panel hereby approved shall be displayed at the end of the bus shelther which does not impair the view in the direction of the oncoming traffic
description: Display of 2 x (back to back) poster panels (1760mm x 1160mm) forming integeral part of bus shelter
